correctness.rationale: Reran inputs/artifacts/census.py end-to-end: reproduced classes (1,21,24,24,42,56), 4032 tuples in each of 12 position patterns totaling 48384, 1 full braid orbit [48384], 288 reduced classes in 1 orbit [288], lift sign split 24120/24264 with braid-stability False. Only failure was the hardcoded research-lane write path (PermissionError), not mathematics. Independently re-implemented checks: (i) A,B product-one, class types (2A,3A,7A,7A)/(2A,7A,7A,3A), generation to order 168, and the 11-move word replayed step-by-step with product-one+generation at every step, endpoint exactly B, sigma/sigma^-1 inverse relations on 200 random tuples; (ii) all-12-pattern recount without generation filter gives 4032 each with 0 non-generating, so generation-automatic holds; (iii) global stabilizer census over all 48384 tuples gives stabilizer 1 everywhere, so conjugation acts freely and |N/G|=48384/168=288 exactly; (iv) braid closure asserted inside BFS (r in NSET) completed without error; (v) outer automorphism diag(1,3) verified to swap 7A/7B and fix 2A,3A, so Inn-quotient is the full class-preserving quotient for multiset {2A,3A,7A,7A}; (vi) degree-7 S4-coset action independently recomputed cycle types 2A:2^2.1^3, 3A:3^2.1, 7A:7, so RH 2(7+g-1)=2+4+6+6=18 gives g=3. The lift non-invariance is honestly reported and consistent with connectedness. Result is a machine-verified exhaustive-enumeration proof (stdlib-only, replayable), correctly distinguished from hand proof.

originality.rationale: Compared substantively against nearest prior: Seguin arXiv:2409.18246 gives asymptotics for component counts as branch points grow, no exact table for (PSL(2,7),(2A,3A,7A,7A)); Fried arXiv:1803.10728 gives Nielsen/braid framework and r=4 genus formula, no orbit census for this class; Salih arXiv:2001.02295 classifies affine-primitive genus-one systems, a disjoint family from almost-simple PSL(2,7) genus-zero 4-point class; LMFDB 168.42 supplies only group order 168, class/element distribution 1+21+56+42+24+24, Aut=PGL(2,7), Schur multiplier C2 — no braid dynamics. Single (2,3,7)-triple integers (Macbeath/Jones-Zvonkin/Garion/Jones-Pierro themes) do not mechanically imply 4-point braid orbits. No source tabulates the 1-component census, the 48384/288 counts, or the explicit braid word. Novel exact global dynamical invariant.

value.rationale: Rigorously established exact invariant (component count = 1, with |N|=48384, |N/G|=288, representatives, generating witnesses, explicit 11-move connectivity path, genus g=3) of the natural 4-point Hurwitz space H(PSL(2,7),(2A,3A,7A,7A)) — the minimal 4-point extension of the classical (2,3,7) theme — motivated before computation by the Fried-Voelklein moduli/inverse-Galois and current component-counting (Seguin asymptotics, Coleman-Oort) programs. Value was unknown and not mechanically implied; a future researcher can cite the precise counts, representative, and witness. Exceeds the admitted fallback (one path + separation lemma) by delivering the full census plus an honest negative lift result. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
